# fairfieldct.ai

> fairfieldct.ai is a volunteer-run local community in Fairfield, Connecticut (USA) for builders, thinkers, and the AI-curious to learn from each other, share what they're making, and talk through what AI means for the town. Technical or not, everyone is welcome. The website is new; the community gathers on Discord and at in-person meetups.

Key facts:

- Location: Fairfield, Connecticut, USA (Fairfield County, on Long Island Sound)
- Contact: hello@inbox.fairfieldct.ai
- Join: create a free account at https://www.fairfieldct.ai/ ("Join the community"), or join the Discord server at https://discord.gg/wC8UCHpXJj
- Meetups: listed at https://www.fairfieldct.ai/events/, where members RSVP with their free account. Organizers schedule them as events in the Discord server, which announces them in #announcements; the /meetup command shows the next one. A calendar feed is at https://www.fairfieldct.ai/api/events.ics.
- Email: members can turn on emails about new meetups and day-before reminders in their account settings at https://www.fairfieldct.ai/account/. Members who RSVP get a reminder the day before and a note if the meetup is canceled.
- Discord Member role: members who link their Discord account at https://www.fairfieldct.ai/connect/discord/ get the Member role through Discord's Linked Roles.
- Planned activities: relaxed meetups about AI and technology (no expertise required), demo nights where members show what they're building, and hands-on learning sessions for using AI tools at work, school, and home.
- Members must be 13 or older. Community guidelines: be respectful; no harassment, spam, or scams; don't share others' personal information; nothing illegal or sexually explicit; don't use AI-generated content to deceive.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.fairfieldct.ai/): What the community is, what's planned, and how to join
- [Meetups](https://www.fairfieldct.ai/events/): Upcoming and past meetups, with RSVPs and a calendar feed
- [Terms of Service](https://www.fairfieldct.ai/terms/): Community guidelines and terms for the site, events, and Discord
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.fairfieldct.ai/privacy/): What data is collected, how it's used and kept, and how to have it deleted

## Community

- [Discord server](https://discord.gg/wC8UCHpXJj): Conversation, show-and-tell, questions, meetup events, and announcements
- [Email](mailto:hello@inbox.fairfieldct.ai): Questions for the organizers, speaking or demo offers, and venue or sponsor ideas

## Optional

- [Website source code](https://github.com/fairfieldai/site): The Next.js site and Rust APIs
- [Infrastructure source code](https://github.com/fairfieldai/infra): Terraform for AWS hosting and the Discord server setup
- [humans.txt](https://www.fairfieldct.ai/humans.txt): Who runs the site and what it's built with
